content.text:
The **next NBA game** appears to be **Knicks @ Spurs — Wednesday, June 3, 2026 at 8:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM PT**, at **Frost Bank Center in San Antonio**. 

Best places to get tickets:

1. **Ticketmaster** — official NBA ticketing partner, and the official marketplace for Spurs tickets. ([help.ticketmaster.com](https://help.ticketmaster.com/hc/en-us/articles/27533401409041-NBA-National-Basketball-Association?utm_source=openai))  
2. **Spurs official ticket page** — Spurs say official tickets can be purchased via **Spurs.com/Ticketmaster**. ([nba.com](https://www.nba.com/spurs/where-to-buy?utm_source=openai))  
3. **Verified resale marketplaces** — StubHub, SeatGeek, Gametime, TickPick, etc. can be options, but compare **total price including fees** and make sure tickets are mobile-transfer/verified. A local report says Game 1 tickets are very expensive, with Ticketmaster entry prices reported around **$1,265+** and some resale sites slightly lower. ([mysanantonio.com](https://www.mysanantonio.com/sports/spurs/article/knicks-vs-spurs-tickets-nba-finals-22284771.php?utm_source=openai))

If you mean the next game **near you** or for a specific team, tell me your city/team and budget and I can narrow it down.
